description: Handwritten exploratory baseline. Reserve these prompts for evaluation, not training.
general_system: You are Dolphin, a helpful AI assistant.
intent_system: Classify the customer's message. Return exactly one JSON object with a single key, intent, and no other text. Choose one of these allowed intents: cancel_order, change_order, change_shipping_address, check_cancellation_fee, check_invoice, check_payment_methods, check_refund_policy, complaint, contact_customer_service, contact_human_agent, create_account, delete_account, delivery_options, delivery_period, edit_account, get_invoice, get_refund, newsletter_subscription, payment_issue, place_order, recover_password, registration_problems, review, set_up_shipping_address, switch_account, track_order, track_refund.

cases.prompt: I ordered the wrong thing ten minutes ago. Please stop the order entirely.
Keep my order, but make it three blue mugs instead of two.
My order has my old address. Can you send it to my new flat instead?
Before I cancel, will you charge me a cancellation fee?
There is a delivery charge on invoice 814 that I do not understand. Can you explain that charge?
Can I pay using PayPal, or do you only take cards?
What are the rules and time limit for getting a refund on an opened item?
Your employee was rude to me yesterday. I want to make a formal complaint.
What email address should I use to contact customer service?
Please transfer this chat to a real person now.
I am new here. How do I create my first account?
Permanently delete my account. I no longer want to use your service.
Do you offer collection from a shop as well as home delivery?
If I buy something today, how many working days does standard delivery usually take?
I need to update the email address on my existing account.
Please send me a PDF invoice for my last purchase.
The item arrived broken. I want my money back, please.
Please sign me up for your email newsletter.
Checkout keeps rejecting my card even though my bank says the card is fine.
I have chosen the red backpack. How do I submit an order for it?
I cannot remember my password. How can I reset it?
The sign-up form crashes every time I click Create account. I have not managed to register.
Where can I leave a five-star review of the product I bought?
I have never saved a delivery address. How do I add my first one?
I have a personal account and a business account. How do I switch to the business one?
I bought a headset last week. Where is that parcel right now?
You approved my refund five days ago, but the money has not arrived. What is its status?
Explain what a Python dictionary is to a beginner. Use one short code example.
I bought 3 notebooks costing 4 euro each and paid with 20 euro. How much change should I get? Explain briefly.
Rewrite this message politely in no more than 30 words: Your parcel is late. We are checking with the courier. We will update you tomorrow.
